title: Why Nails on a Chalkboard Make Your Brain Panic
caption:
That nails-on-chalkboard cringe? It's a predator alarm.
A stick-figure kid accidentally slides his fingernails down a chalkboard and shudders head to toe.
That 2000-4000 Hz screech matches predator screams, so your amygdala, the brain's ancient alarm, reacts as if a tiger is coming.
Which sound triggers your full-body cringe the most?
Share this with the friend who dreads chalkboard sounds.
